name: devin
description: Devin MCP server with API key authentication — private repository wikis, wiki generation and the organization-wide devin_* tools.

api_key.description: Devin API key, sent as the Authorization: Bearer header. Required for this server. Create one at https://app.devin.ai/settings/api-keys.

org_id.description: Optional Devin organization id, sent as the X-Org-Id header. It selects the organization that the devin_* tools act in; without it the server resolves the first organization the key belongs to.
